text_block_list.name: Biko & Bono
text_block_list.text: Great work at training camp, everyone!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The final day of the training camp. Having poured their all into both play and training, the two of them looked thoroughly satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That was so much fun~~~!
It was hard, buono, and oh-so-rich in flavor!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! It was super fulfilling!
The fishing and the summer festival were both the absolute best!
choice_data_list: We did plenty of distance running, after all.
We did plenty of distance running, after all.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We worked this hard.
Next up is the Sprinters Stakes...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! The next one is
the "Sprinters Stakes," is it?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Which means,
you really do intend to compete with me, then.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Bakushin O-senpai! Of course.
In the 'Sprinters Stakes',
I'm going to become a strong hero...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
No, I won't just be strong!
I'm gonna be "an even greater hero"!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho, it seems you've taken
my lesson from the other day firmly to heart.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "So, Biko-san. What kind of hero is one who isn't just strong?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
What kind of hero?
I don't really know that yet, but~...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, right now, I'm gonna show speed
that won't lose to Bakushin O-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see. Well, very well then. But can you really defeat me?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Lately, I've had a winning streak in races under 1400m. I haven't lost a single one."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Can you truly—compete with me?
With this—peak invincible Class Rep?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ugh...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What Sakura Bakushin O said was no exaggeration. In fact, over the course of last year to this year—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Undefeated with a perfect win record at 1,400m and below.
Truly a runner standing at the pinnacle of the sprint world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Going toe-to-toe with them won't be an easy feat, but...
choice_data_list: Don't flinch, Biko! You're a hero!
Don't flinch, Biko! You're a hero!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
Right, I don't know if I can win, but...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I'm a hero! And heroes don't flinch,
Bakushin O-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, very well.
That fiery spirit is precisely what I've been waiting for!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "Please be the worthy home for this armband. I'm expecting great things from you!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I'll definitely put on the best match possible!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus is getting his fighting spirit back.
That's great. But there was one thing that caught my attention.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What did they mean by "the armbands' final destination"?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Miss, can you hear the sound of the waves?
Look, look, can you see the ocean too~~?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Yes, perfect!
Wow, what an incredible, vast ocean."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I found this place while out running, and
I just had to show it to you, big sis!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I trained a whole, whole lot
and got super strong! How about you, big sis?

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"As for me~ not much has changed, I guess.
I haven't been passing many auditions either."

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"I know I have to do something about it.
Even so, it's easier said than done..."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: I see... That sounds tough.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Still, let's give it our all!
I'm going to take on a massive wall, so you should too, big sis!

text_block_list.name: Action Actor
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah, I'll come cheer you on whenever I can.
See you later."

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: She's also working hard... with the spirit of Carrotman held close to her heart.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I have to get stronger, stronger, and stronger...
so I won't lose either!
Even if my opponent is Bakushin O-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
I won't lose!
Uwoooooooooooh!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The battle cry of a newly awakened hero.
With friendship in her heart, Biko Pegasus—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: This autumn, I will challenge Sakura Bakushin O.
